title: BeerSmith Batch Failure Rate
dataSources: Fermentation gravity/temperature (`brew:fermentation`), kegerator pours (`kegerator:pour`), wine-cellar climate (`winecellar:reading`).
app: Fermentation sensors (Tilt/iSpindel hydrometer, temperature), kegerator flow meters and scales, and wine-cellar climate sensors via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=beersmith:batch
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(batch_status,"unknown"))
| eval failed=if(match(status_value,"error|fail|alert|overdue|late|stale|breach"),1,0)
| stats count as events, sum(failed) as failed_events by recipe_name
| eval failure_pct=round(100*failed_events/events,1)
| sort - failure_pct - failed_events
description: Measures how often BeerSmith batch records land in an unhealthy or exception state for each recipe.
value: A plain failure-rate view highlights noisy devices, flaky automations, and habits that repeatedly slip.
implementation: Normalize batch_status values into good or bad states and review the failure percentage per recipe.
visualization: Bar chart of failure percentage by entity.
grandmaExplanation: It scans which parts of your BeerSmith batch data keep ending up in a bad state instead of working cleanly.
